---
title: "Cinema"
subtitle: "Interactive 3D model"
description: >
  A cinema auditorium shown in the browser. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom —
  the model is only downloaded once you click. Pick a highlighted seat to hear
  the same cello passage as it sounds from there.
date: 2026-10-14
model: /assets/models/cinema.obj
# No `mtl:` — the Blender export's .mtl is empty and the OBJ has no usemtl
# statements, so the viewer's own lighting does all the work.
poster: /images/models/cinema.jpg
kind: Scene
categories: [Model]
# Listening positions. `position` is [x, y, z] in the OBJ's coordinates, at
# roughly seated ear height. Rows count back from the screen (row 1 is nearest);
# seats count from the -x side wall. All clips are the same passage and length,
# so switching seats keeps the playback position.
seats:
  - label: "Row 1, seat 8"
    position: [1.66, -0.79, 3.58]
    audio: /assets/audio/cinema/cello_r1s8.m4a
  - label: "Row 4, seat 5"
    position: [-0.70, 0.52, -0.69]
    audio: /assets/audio/cinema/cello_r4s5.m4a
  - label: "Row 6, seat 3"
    position: [-2.28, 1.76, -3.57]
    audio: /assets/audio/cinema/cello_r6s3.m4a
  - label: "Row 7, seat 1"
    position: [-3.85, 2.38, -5.00]
    audio: /assets/audio/cinema/cello_r7s1.m4a
